title: Dead Drop
subtitle: Recover a concealed intel package from the outpost

briefing.title: Priority Intercept
lines: A rebel operative left a datacard hidden in the eastern corridor.
Retrieve it before Imperial patrols find it.
Bring it to R5-D4 for decoding.

steps.title: Retrieve Dead Drop
steps.description: Locate the concealed datacard near the eastern corridor

hint.text: Look near the wall panel with the flickering light

on_complete.message: Datacard recovered. Get it to R5-D4 for analysis.

steps.title: Deliver to R5-D4
steps.description: Find the rebel droid and hand off the intel

completion.summary: You recovered concealed rebel intelligence and delivered it safely.
